_comment: The chain of custody as eight stations — the spine shared by /lifecycle and the unpublished draft home page. Endpoints are the engine's real routes. Stations 6, 7 and 8 are the ones the live home page never reaches, and they are the three with no competitor equivalent. Every 'who' is an actor named in law, not an invented persona.

stations.title: Declare
stations.lead: The data arrives the way it actually exists: spreadsheets.
stations.body: CSV and Excel, with a dry run that reports errors per row rather than rejecting the file. Nobody's product data starts life in a schema, and a tool that insists otherwise is a tool nobody can start using.

stations.title: Evidence
stations.lead: A document a supplier has not sent is visible as a gap, not as a blank.
stations.body: Evidence is a first-class object with its own address and its own verification, rather than a field someone filled in. The difference matters when an auditor asks where a number came from.

stations.title: Check
stations.lead: Checked against the product group's signed ruleset, before anything is signed.
stations.body: Rules arrive as signed bundles and are verified fail-closed. When a threshold changes, the ruleset changes — not the software, and not a redeploy.

stations.title: Seal
stations.lead: Signed with the operator's own key, on their own infrastructure. Claims freeze here.
stations.body: The identity is a did:web in a domain they control. Nothing is sent anywhere to be signed, which is the difference between holding a record and renting access to it.

stations.title: Resolve
stations.lead: Scan the code, get the public view. No login, no fee — because the regulation says so.
stations.body: A GS1 Digital Link when the product is identified by a GTIN, and a plain passport URL when it is not. Requiring the barcode would mean requiring GS1 membership.

stations.title: Disclose
stations.lead: Depth proven by credential, not by a header the caller sets.
stations.body: The same record answers differently depending on who is asking, enforced per field. For batteries this is a lattice rather than a ladder: an authority sees less than a recycler in one specific respect.

stations.title: Hand over
stations.lead: Responsibility changes hands with both parties' signatures on the record.
stations.body: Remanufacture, repurposing, a sold product line. The chain of custody is part of the passport rather than an email thread, and either side can refuse or withdraw.

stations.title: End
stations.lead: A typed end of life, and a dossier that verifies with no network and no trust in us.
stations.body: Passport, signatures, identity documents and the full hash-chained history in one signed file. Someone who has never heard of Odal Node can check it offline.
